tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral lha brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa'i ru mtshon 'dzugs chog nag 'gros glegs grol bzhugs so// na mo gu ru shrī ma hā kā la ye/ 'dir gur lha brgyad kyi ru mtshon 'dzugs chog nag 'gros ma ni/ lcang shug gang rung gi srog shing 'dom gang sogs mtshal btsag dug khrag rnams kyis dmar po bsgyur rtser/ shā sa na'i mthar gur lha brgyad ru mtshon 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas bstan 'gro spyi dang bye brag dgon gnas 'di'i 'gal rkyen sel mthun rkyen sgrubs/ dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod par mdzad du gsol lta bu bris pa'i gsung rten dug khrag gis byugs pa dkris pa'i phyi nas dar sna lnga dang tshon skud kyis bcings/ thug so ral gri so gnyis ma'i yu ba'i steng gi so lhag g.yas g.yon la a long nyis brtsegs yu ba lcags sbug yod pa de bskyon/ 'brong ngam g.yag 'bras bu can gyi rnga phung che bar bsgron pa'i khrod du sku rten/ ro ras sor bzhir mgon sku gri khrag gis bris pa phyag g.yas nas sgril la/ gong bzhin dar sna dang tshon skud kyis dkris pa smyug lcags gang rung gi sbubs su bcug pa/ srog 'khor shes na dang mi shes na gong gi gsung rten des 'thus/ gri lcags kyi me long la gri khrag dang sin+dhu ras hūm̐ bris pa'i thugs rten/ dar ras kyi khug mar 'bru sman rin po che sna tshogs kyis bkang ba'i yon tan/ gla tshal lta bu drag shing tsher ma can gyi byang bu mtho gang la shā sa nas spel tshig bcas gong bzhin dang / bse lcags kyi khrab byang mig dgu/ stag gzig ras ma/ mgron bu dril g.yer/ mi'i mgo lag snying sogs bris 'bur gang rung / dar ras sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa te 'phrin las kyi rten de rnams kyang rab gnas can btags la sku gzugs sogs chu skyon mi 'byung ba'i phyir la sgril can no/

/sbyangs khrus dang gsol kha'i chas rnams bshams/ de lta bu'i thug chen de mgon khang sogs kyi steng du 'dzugs pa'am/ rta thug lta bus khyer dgos yod na/ mañdzi chen po la rten pa'am/ phyogs bzhir brgyang thag byas la bzhugs/ de'i mdun stegs bu'i khar gtor ma gru gsum che ba mtheb skyus bskor ba sha khrag dang dar gyis brgyan pa/ gsol kha'i chas kyi sha dum bu/ khrag chang phye mar mchod pa rnam lnga la sogs pa legs par bshams/ sgrub pa po rnams kyis gnas yo byin rlabs sngon 'gro'i bdag bskyed kyai rdor lam dus byas la/ bum pa rdor gzungs can/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i zhes pa nas nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i nang du zhes pa'i bar spyi 'gre la/ paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng hūm̐ ljang sngon yongs su gyur pa las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje thugs dkar 'dzin zhing / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur bstan pa/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa stag gi lpags pa'i shal thabs can zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskums pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma zhes pa nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza ni ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ sogs chu bzhi dang nyer mchod rol mo rnams sngags tsam gyis phul ba'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza oṃ badz+ra gau rī nas ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ slar yang rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza/

oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wa ra nī ri sogs gong bzhin mchod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun sogs nas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ mtshan sngags re re 'gor sbyar ba'i chu bzhi nyer mchod rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi nang mchod/ dril gsil rol chen dang bcas pas dkar mo ri dwags nas 'khyud pa nyid kyi bar/ don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas sogs sh+lau ka gcig rang gi snying kha nas sngags kyi phreng ba dmar po gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas bum nang gi lha dmar lam lam song ste sku'i ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ a mṛ ta brgya rtsa bzlas pa'i mthar gong ltar mchod bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ he ru ka'i yig brgya tshar gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sh+lau ka gcig oṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi lha 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ gtor ma gsum chus bran la mchod g.yog pas gtor ma gsum re re bzhin brten gsar ma rnams la g.yas phyogs su bskor ba'i tshul bya zhing / dpon slob thams cad kyis phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya g.yas phyogs bskor zhing / mthar se gol gtogs pa byin rlabs mi dgos la/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yaḥ sarba tha khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga na khaṃ gṛh+ne daṃ ba l+yā dī swāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ ting lo dang chang bu gong bzhin bskor la/ dpon slob rnams kyis rdo rje gsor zhing / oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐/ gṛh+na gṛh+na hūm̐/ gṛ ha na pa ya gṛ ha na pa ya hūm̐/ ā na ya ho/ bha ga wān bi d+ya rā dzaḥhūm̐ phaṭaḥ lan gsum/ 'dir dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral/ bran g.yog bka' bstod 'khor dang bcas pa'i rten ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa la bar du gcod par rtsom pa'i gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma lam brngan/

ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig ces brjod la gtor ma chang bu rnams rgyang ring du dor la/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo me ltar 'bar ba la ye shes kyi khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dhā rā dza sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ zhes brjod cing gdangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can/ /log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs gsol 'tshal/ /log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dhā rā dza sa pā ri wā ra e h+ye hi badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ā+oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ/ oṃ ma hā kro dhā rā dza sa pa ri wā ra a/ puṣ+pe/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo kaṃ ghan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ dril gsil gdangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spongs zhing / /thabs la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa/ /khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can/ /gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra/ /ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing / /bsdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ /nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'dzoms mdzad pa/ /sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /skal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /dpa' bo'i stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis/

/bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs/ /rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrogs/ /khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa tshar gcig dang / 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing / /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pa'i sh+lau ka gcig po lan gsum brjod/ de nas dpon slob rnams kyis kyai rdo rje'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun kyi bka' bden pa dang / bcom ldan 'das snying po kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / dpal mgon chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis/ deng 'dir dpal rdo rje nag po chen po sogs nas gcod par bar gong bzhin la/ rtsom pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa thams cad la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyong ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas des tshim par gyis la/ zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig gal te mi 'gro ba thams cad la dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje ye shes kyi me 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /thug yungs kar gyis brabs/ gu gul gyis bdug rol mo'i sgra drag po bya zhing / oṃ sum+bha ni sogs brjod pa lan gsum/ rten rab gnas can gyi gzugs brnyan me long du shar bar sku khrus gsol la/

ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams gyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī hūm̐/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod/ /oṃ sarba༞ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyis chus/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang ba'i glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /ces brjod cing sna tshogs rol mo bya/ oṃ sarba༞ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang ma dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ /oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā kā ya bi shwa dha ni swāhāḥ zhes pas sku phyis par bsam mo/ /rten khrus zhus pa'i chu de bum par blugs la/ thug la'ang khrus de bzhin byas la/ phyin drug gang la gser sna 'jug gi khrus gsol bcas dpe 'dir ched dam snyam/ rten dang gtor ma rnams nang mchod kyis sbyangs pa/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ gtor ma mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can bsgral ba'i sha khrag gi rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i ri bo/ zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ zhes brjod cing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ phyag rgyar bcas pa ci mang brjod/ ru mtshon/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su pad+ma nyi ma mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag che zhing cher 'bar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje gri gug

g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs khar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ phyag gnyis kyi dbus na rnam 'phrul gser gyi gaṇ+ḍe bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ zhal mche ba brtsigs shing ljags sgril ma/ dbu skra dang smin ma sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod paṇa dang lhab lhub kyis bklubs pa/ mi'u thung gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas na bya nag g.yon na khyi nag rgyab na ce spyang / mdun na mi nag steng na nam mkha' lding gi sprul pa'i pho nya 'phro ba mi bskyod pa'i cod paṇa can/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du ṭaṃ las e ka dza ṭī sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thugs khar 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bzas stod g.yogs shing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ral pa'i lan bu gcig tu gyur nas g.yon du 'phyang ba/ khro mo'i rnam pa can/ de'i lto ba yangs pa'i nang du/ trag las khrag gi rgya mtsho'i nang du bh+yo las dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma bong bu gwa pa la zhon pa sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas kyi dang po na ral gri/ gnyis pa na thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na mdung thung / gnyis pas rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ glang po che'i ko bas stod g.yogs shing ba lang gi ko bas smad g.yogs pa/ re lde'i sham thabs can/ klu'i dbang pos ske rags bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ mi ro rengs pa khar bcug nas mche ba gtsigs pa/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul dang / g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/

sku la khrag gis thig le dang / zhag gi zo ris dang / thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ shin tu rid pa lte ba'i thad ka nas nyi zla 'char ba/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na hūm̐ dang bh+yoḥ'i sgra sgrog pa/ mgon po'i thugs kha nas yaṃ/ lha mo'i thugs kha nas maṃ mdun du spros pa las/ yaṃ las nag po gnod sbyin sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas lcags kyi gri gug g.yon spar ba gdengs pa'i mthil du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi na bza' dang / mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi gyon pa/ maṃ las nag mo gnod sbyin g.yas gser gyi spu gri dang / g.yon spar ba gdengs pa'i mthil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ byi ru'i lan tshar can/ yab las triḥtriḥdang yum las bh+yoḥspros pa las pu tra ming sring gsum du gyur te/ triḥlas las kyi mgon po pu tra nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa lcags kyi ral gri dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar gyi aṅga rag dang / dar nag gi na bzas brgyan pa/ triḥlas bha tra nag po stag slog can g.yas sher shing gi dam shing dang / g.yon mi'i snying 'dzin pa/ bh+yoḥlas srin mo khrag mig ma kha nas me 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas spu gri g.yon mi'i rgyu ma 'dzin cing / za 'og nag khra'i gos gyon pa lnga ka'ang sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros pa/ rus pa'i rgyan dang / mi mgo skam po'i dbu rgyan dang / dgra bgegs kyi rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa'i do shal can/ gzhan yang g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya/ g.yon gyi ru 'dren pa dge slong mkhar gsil thogs pa brgya/ rgyab kyi ru 'dren sngags nag ban phur 'dzin pa brgya/ mdun gyi shul byang 'dren pa bud med nag mo spar ba gdengs pa brgya/ gzhan yang dam nyams kyi rjes gcod pa'i bya nag khyi nag lce spyang / mi nag la sogs pa pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba de rnams kyi mdun du dur khrod kyi sa gzhir/

raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba'i dbus su bdud rta bra nag rdzu 'phrul gyi shugs dang ldan pa/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa'i steng du ru mtshon gyi las mkhan bran bdud gshin rje nag po mun pa'i mdog can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bdud kyi khram shing rtse mo gsum ba'i mgul na/ dar nag gi ba dan dang / mi mgo'i lan tshar 'phyang ba sku la brten pa/ g.yon pas mi snying rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa dug sbrul nag po'i zhags pa dang bcas pa zhal du 'jibs shing phyir sprug pa/ lcags kyi ral pa nag po drag tu sprug cing gsig pa/ lcags kyi mche ba zangs yag tu gtsigs nas ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ sku stod la dar nag gi ber zhol gsol zhing / sku smad gcer bu la dug sbrul mang po lang long du dkris pa/ skad cig nyid la stong gsum yud kyis bskor zhing / dgra bgegs kyi srog dbugs sdud pa'i drag shul can/ de'i g.yon phyogs su ma bdud spu gri'i mched mo dud pa'i mdog srin mo khros pa'i gzugs can/ gcer mo rgyan med/ rkang pa gsum bgrad stabs kyis gnas pa/ phyag gnyis me dpung 'bar ba 'dzin zhing / kha nas me 'bar zhing gdong phyir phyogs pa/ yab yum gnyis ka'ang me rlung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ bdud mgon bdun brgya dang / gza' bdud brgya la sogs pa'i dregs pa can bsam gyis mi khyab pa pho nyar 'gyed pa de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ thugs kha'i dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ bh+yoḥ yaṃ/ maṃ/ triḥ triḥ bh+yoḥya rnams las 'od 'phros/ 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi pho brang / rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang nas mgon po dang / sum cu rtsa gsum lha mo'i mkhar sogs nas lha mo/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas las mgon pho nya 'khor dang bcas pa dang / lho phyogs ri rab kyi khong seng nas/ bran bdud gshin rje nag po 'khor dang bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes dang se gol gyi sgra bya/ rdo rje g.yab dril bu gsil rkang gling gi sgra dang bcas/ hūm̐/ mgon po kun gshegs gdan la bzhengs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs zhing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang / /shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gnas 'dir nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /lha mo kun gshegs༞ /da lta snyigs ma༞ /gshegs zhing bzhugs༞ /shākya'i༞ /bdag cag༞ /gnas 'dir༞ /las mgon kun gshegs༞ /da lta༞ /gshegs shing༞ /shākya'i༞ /bdag cag༞ /gnas 'dir༞ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wī/ sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ pad+ma ka ma la ya satwaṃ/ gdan phul/ oṃ a/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo ke ghan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de nas chos skyong gi dam tshig phyag rgya bcas la/ ā+oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ lha mo'i dam rgya bcas la/ ma hā kā li de wī/ mgon po'i dam rgya bzhin bcas la/ badz+ra kā la yak+ṣa/ kā li yak+ṣi ni/ yak+ṣa pu tra/ ru tra/ bha ṭa/ ru lu rak+ṣa sī/ ya ma rā dzaḥ sa pa ri bā ra/ sa ma ya sma ra si/ sa ma ya ma ti kra ma/ sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' bstod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ dam tshig srungs/ bstan pa skyongs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ khyad par du yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams dang / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba dang / bdag gi lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kyi bsam ngan sbyor rtsub thams cad zhi ba'i thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad du gsol/ gal te zhi ba'i thab kyis 'dul du ma 'tshal na/

thal mo brdab cing gang la gang 'tshams pa'i chad pas bcad pa dang / bskrad cing gzir ba dang / dbye ba dang / bsdigs shing dpa' bkong bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na chos sgrub pa'i bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bsam sbyor chos mthun yid bzhin du sgrub cing / bstan pa dang bstan pa 'dzin pa dang / 'jig rten pa kun dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing dam la bzhag rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wī sa pa ri wā ra/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ/ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ grih+ne daṃ ba le di swāhā/ lnga'am bdun dang / oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ shā sa ṇo pa ri ṇi/ e ṣa a pañtsi ma ka lo ya mi di/ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇi/ ya ti twaṃ/ pra ti dz+nyā/ sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭan/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ lan gsum/ oṃ ro ru ro ru/ bi tiṣ+ṭha/ ba dho si/ ka ma la rak+kha si hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ a li a li ma/ dza dzaḥ shaṃ shaṃ/ li shi ded/ a shwa ded/ mo rmugs spu gri a li ma dza dza/ nag mo sha la rub dza dza/ oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la/ a shug me/ ma hūm̐ ma bh+yoḥdza dzaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñtsa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba sha trun bigh+nān mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ lan gsum/ ma hā kā la yak+ṣa mud tsa kro dha ya mā rā dza hūm̐ bh+yo ma ri ma sha mud tsa ya bh+yo sarba bigh+nān sha trun mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas gtor ma 'bul/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wī sa pa ri wā ra a/ sogs gong ltar mchod/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ ro ru ro ru sogs kyi mjug tu gong ltar 'bru gsum/ oṃ badz+ra ka la yak+ṣa/ kā li yak+ṣi ṇi yak+ṣa pu tra/ ru tra bha ṭa/

ru lu rak+kha si/ sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bran bdud kyi sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum brjod pas nang mchod phul/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' bstod 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang / bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing / mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas dar 'phyar sha chen tshil chen gyi dud pa dang / rnga rol gyi sgra/ rkang gling g.yab dar shugs pa sogs bsgrigs la/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba dang / mdun bskyed rnams kyi thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ nag po chen po lcam dral gyis gtso mdzad pa'i dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ring pa'i bcom rol byas la/ sh+lau ka gcig la dbyangs ring dang gnyis la dbyangs thung rol mo bcas/ hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas rnams/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi dad pa dang / /sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /'dir gshegs bdag gi 'phrin las mdzod/ /hūm̐ bh+yoḥ lha chen ma hā kā la dang / /e ka dza ṭī re ma ti/ /gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra gnyis/ /sring mor bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /sgo ma bzhi dang ru 'dren bzhi/ /pho nya dgu dang gaṇ+ḍe'i dmag /dur khrod bdag po phyogs skyong bcu/ /sde brgyad dregs pa gnas 'dir gshegs/ /sprin ltar 'thibs pas 'dir gshegs shig /glog ltar 'khyugs pas 'dir gshegs shig /'brug ltar grags pas 'dir gshegs shig /thog ltar 'dril bas 'dir gshegs shig /hūm̐ rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas pa/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas 'di ru/ /drag po'i las la spyan 'dren gshegs/

/dam can mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas/ /byin rlabs yon tan 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /bde chen rol pa'i gzhal yas khang / /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i gdan la bzhugs/ /hūm̐ sbyar ba'i spos dang g.yab pa'i dar/ /rnga chen sgra dang dung chen gling / /rnal 'byor drag po'i ngar skad kyis/ /spyan 'dren ma thog myur du byon/ /dam can rgya mtsho mthu rtsal can/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba rnams/ /gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /dam tshig dbang gis 'dus gyur cig /sh+lau ka gsum la tshig rol re dang / tshig rkang brgyad kyi rjes su tshig rol gyi mthar chems rdung / gur yi ge bdun ma/ oṃ e ka dza ṭī de wī in+t+ra si bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ lha mo'i ro ru/ las mgon gyi ro ru tri tsa dang / a li bran bdud kyi ma hā kā la nas/ murtsa ya bh+yo/ e h+ye hi/ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod cing drag rol yun ring du bya/ chems brdung gi mthar gsum brdeg len can rol bskor 'bebs bcas byas la rnga rol bzhag oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya ma hā kā li de wī sa pā ri wā ra grih+ne dam a/ pā d+yaṃ/ nas/ shap+ta pra tits+tsha swāhās phyi mchod/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de wī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi nang mchod/ rang nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs kha nas 'od zer dmar nag tsha zhing rtsub pa 'phros/ mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas kyi sku la phog pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ thugs kha nas rang 'dra ba'i pho nya las mkhan nam mkha'i mtha' khyab par 'phros/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad/ 'khor 'das kyi nus mthu thams cad tshur 'dus mdun bskyed rnams la thim pas gzi brjid nus pa lta bar mi bzod pa khams gsum thams cad 'dar khri li li yod par gyur zhes dang / thug la gzungs thag btags pa bzung la/ shā sa nā ji tsam bzlas pa'i phyed/ e ka dza ṭī dang / lha mo/

de'i phyed las mgon pho mo'i bod rbad bsad gsum dang / bran bdud la bzlas sngags dug khrag la btab ste thug sor byugs/ sgrub grogs mang du yod na/ gcig gis 'og gi bskul mi byed par/ shā sa na'i sngags rgyun ma chad par bzung / gzhan rnams kyis gsol kha bya ste/ de dag sngar gyi stegs bu'i kha'i gtor ma che ba'i g.yas su sha dmar po dum bu dgu dang / chang phud gtsang ma bzhag g.yon du phye mar dang khrag chab bzhag mdun du las kyi rdo rje zhig gis lcags snod gtsang ma'i nang du g.yas nas sha re/ g.yon nas phye mar mtheb skyu re bcug gsol kha tshar re la de 'dra ba lan gsum gtor chen la bstabs cing / g.yas g.yon nas khrag chang kyang thigs re blug rnal 'byor pa gzhan rnams kyis rol mo'i bye brag kun thogs nas/ mdun gyi gtor rdzas dgra bgegs kyi sha'i ri bo/ khrag gi rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i gram khrod chen pos stong gsum thams cad khyab par bsam/ de rnams mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal dmar gnam sa tsam gdangs pa'i nang du sib kyis bstabs pas hab thob tu bzhes nas thugs rgyud zag med kyi bde bas mnyes nas/ bdag gi ci bcol ba'i las thams cad thogs pa med par bsgrub par bsams la/ sh+lau ka gnyis la 'jam rdor ma'i dbyangs kyi mthar rol mo/ de 'phros 'dur ma byas mthar gsum brdeg len can bsdus pa bcas/ hūm̐ mgon po'i mtshan gsol dpal ldan nag po che/ /rgyal ba'i bstan srung bka' yi bya ra dang / /gdug pa tshar gcod drag shul mthu rtsal ldan/ /bdud 'dul dpal bo lcam dral 'khor bcas rnams/ /bdag cag rnams la brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ /'dod yon rgya chen gtor ma'i rgya mtsho dang / /longs spyod sna tshogs zhal zas mchod pa 'di/ /dpal ldan nag po lcam dral 'khor bcas rnams/ /gus pa'i tshul gyis mchod pa dam par 'bul/ /dges pa'i sems kyis mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /sngon gyi thugs rje 'phrin las nyer dgongs la/

/bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams ma lus zhi ba dang / /'dod don mthun pa'i rkyen rnams ma lus 'grub pa dang / /thub pa'i bstan pa mtha' dag rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /de nas 'dur dbyangs bya zhing / hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po nag po sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po rgyal ba'i bka' srung dam pa/ lha srung yongs kyi ded dpon/ dur khrod kun gyi bdag po/ rig 'dzin yongs kyi srog shing / rnal 'byor kun gyi dgra lha/ bstan pa yongs kyi bya ra ba/ dug gsum nad kyi sman pa/ bdud 'dul rnams kyi dpa' bo/ ma hā de ba'i sras mchog lha chen dpal 'bar/ 'jigs byed chen po/ dam nyams kun gyi srog gcod/ mna' zan kun gyi gshed ma/ gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams kyi bdud pho khyed kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes brjod cing mgon po'i gtor sngags/ shā sa na lan gsum rol chen dang bcas pas gsol kha dang po bstabs/ yang sngar bzhin bshams la/ gzhan yang dpal ldan lha mo nag mo chen mo/ 'dod khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ dur khrod kyi bdag mo/ gshin rje'i lcam mo/ bdud rtsi sman gyi rgyal mo/ bdud kyi yum chen/ nad do cog gi bdag mo/ 'khor gyi ma mo mkha' 'gro/ dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ bdud 'dul gyi dmag dpung nyi khri chig stong / lha dmag bye ba dung phyur/ phyogs skyong / zhing skyong / dur khrod kyi bdag po/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad/ bka' nyan gyi gnod sbyin yab yum/ las mkhan mon pa ming sring / mdun gyi shul 'dren/ g.yas g.yon gyi ru 'dren/ rgyab kyi rjes nyul/ mkha' lding / bya nag khyi nag lce spyang sngon po/ mi nag po 'o dod can/ sprul pa'i khro bo'i tshogs/ bdud nag po gshin rje'i tshogs gdong can gyi tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mchod pa dam par 'bul zhing gsol lo/

/mchod do/ /rol chen dang / lha mo las mgon rnams kyi gtor sngags bzlas shing gsol kha gnyis pa bstabs/ yang bshams la/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' dang bstan pa rin po che la dgongs te khyed rnams kyis dges shing mos pa'i thabs kyis bzhes la/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi nad dang gnod pa/ gdon bgegs thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas par spel/ dbang phyug dang nus mthu bskyed/ snyan pa dang grags pa sgrubs/ dregs pa'i 'gro ba pho mo thams cad dbang du bsdus/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad thal ba rdul du rlog cig gzhan yang bdag cag rnams kyi rgyags chad kyi ma dang / blo lhag gi pha mdzod cig rgyab kyi slog pa dang / mdun gyi 'khar ba mdzod/ nyin gsum gyi bya ra dang / mtshan gsum gyi mel tshe mdzod/ yo na srongs/ 'gyel na slongs/ chad na 'thud cig ral na tshems shig stor na tshol la/ brjed na skul cig mgo gang gi yar ma bstod la/ dkyus gang gi mar ma srings shig gzhan yang legs pa brgya sprod la/ nyes pa stong dang bsnol cig bsam pa yid bzhin du sgrubs la/ re ba rgya mtsho lta bur skyongs shig mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol la/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bzlog cig gnod byed kyi dgra bgegs bzlog pa'i ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan la brtan par bzhugs te/ dgra dpung choms la bgegs dpung thams cad shigs cig dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon 'phyor cig sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs shig dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang chen po bstod cig gzhan yang spo la dar 'phyor la/ khrom du dung bus shig gtam ngan rgyun chad la/ snyan grags 'jig rten du sgrogs shig dam chos mi nub pa'i rgyal 'tshan nam mkha' la 'phyor la/ mtho ris dang thar pa dang byang chub sgrub pa'i mgon grogs mdzod cig skyabs dang dpung gnyen dang rten dang brling mdzod cig

bdag cag gi ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin bcol ba'i phrin las thams cad myur du sgrubs shig ces 'khor bcas dril ba'i sngags rnams rol chen dang bcas pas gsol kha gsum pa bstabs/ de nas mnga' gsol dpangs bstod rgyas par bya ba ni/ sh+lau ka gcig la srin gzugs ma'i dbyangs rol gzhan 'dur ma bcas/ hūm̐ dpal chen thugs kyi srung la mchog /lha chen mgon po nag po la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas mnga' gsol bas/ /dngos grub stsol zhing lam mchog ston/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis mnga' gsol bas/ /bslu med thar pa'i lam sna 'dren/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtshos mnga' gsol bas/ /bar chad sel zhing sgrub po skyong / /dpa' bo dpa' mos mnga' gsol bas/ /dam tshig ldan pa bsrung zhing skyong / /dam can yongs kyis mnga' gsol bas/ /bstan pa'i dgra bgegs thal bar rlog /pho nya'i tshogs kyis mnga' gsol bas/ /myur mgyogs rno ba'i stobs dang ldan/ /bran gyi tshogs kyis༞ /rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /lha chen rnams kyis༞ /rin chen mdzes pa'i rgyan cha can/ /klu chen rnams kyis༞ /sbrul chen 'jigs pa'i chun pos dkris/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyis༞ /dar gos 'jol ber lhab lhub can/ /ma mo rnams kyis༞ /rims nad dal yams dgra la 'phen/ /gza' chen rnams kyis༞ /drag po'i gnam lcags thog ser 'bebs/ /bdud chen rnams kyis༞ /dgra la gnag pa'i thugs dang ldan/ /rgyal chen rnams kyis༞ /sangs rgyas bstan dang dkor mdzod bsrungs/ /gying chen rnams kyis༞ /'jigs pa'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston/ /btsan rgod rnams kyis༞ /dgra srog gcod la myur du brtson/ /gshin rje rnams kyis༞ /khams gsum 'dul ba'i mthu rtsal can/ /phyogs skyong rnams kyis༞ /phyogs bcur dbang zhing 'phrin las mdzad/ /dpal mgon bdun cus༞ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa bu bzhin skyong / /srung ma drug cus༞ /dam tshig ldan pa'i bar chad srung / /chos kyi dbyings kyis mnga' gsol bas/

/mi 'gyur nam mkha'i mdangs dang ldan/ /sangs rgyas rigs lngas༞ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la mdzes/ /rgyal ba drug gis mnga' gsol bas/ /rus pa'i rgyan chen drug gis mdzes/ /dregs pa yongs kyis༞ /dpal gyi chas chen brgyad kyis brgyan/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed༞ /mgo rlon lnga bcu'i do shal byas/ /chos sgra chen pos༞ /rnam 'phrul gaṇ+ḍe phyag dbus bsnams/ /dregs pa sde brgyad mnga' gsol bas/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /srin po'i tshogs kyis༞ /rngam pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog /sha za'i tshogs kyis༞ /dgra sha za zhing dgra srog gcod/ /rgyal chen bzhi yis༞ /bstan pa bsrung zhing 'jig rten skyong / /rgyu skar rnams kyis༞ /'jig rten sna tshogs las rnams byed/ /sa bdag rnams kyis༞ /gdug pa'i nad kyis dgra bgegs 'joms/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyis༞ /rnal 'byor sgrub po'i bar chad sel/ /dbang chen rnams kyis༞ /khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud/ /nor lha rnams kyis༞ /tshe dang 'byor pa 'khor rnams spel/ /khro chen rnams kyis༞ /dgra bgegs log 'dren rlog par mdzad/ /gter bdag rnams kyis༞ /'dod dgu'i longs spyod char bzhin 'bebs/ /hūm̐ lha chen dpal 'bar mthu bo che/ /lcam dral pho nyar bcas pa dang / /zhing skyong dbang phyug gzi ldan dang / /dkar mo bdud rgyal trag shad dang / /che btsan drag po stag la zhon/ /phyag bzhi bya rog gdong can dang / /phyag drug bde dang legs ldan tshogs/ /ma ning gri gug zangs gri can/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /gzi brjid chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /mthu rtsal chen por dbang bskur ro/ /drag shul chen por dpangs bstod do/ /thugs rje ldan par gsol 'debs so/ /'phrin las mdzad par bdag bskul lo/ /dgra bo sgrol bar dus 'debs so/ /hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po nag po khyod/ /lha chen brgyad kyis bskor ba'i tshe/

/dpal 'bar lha yi gtso bo mdzad/ /lha dmag 'bum dang bcas te gshegs/ /dpal ldan༞ /'gre'o/ /dbang phyug brgyad kyis bskor ba'i tshe/ /ma hā de ba'i sras po mdzad/ /gnod sbyin 'bum dang bcas te gshegs/ /hūm̐ dpal ldan༞ /tshogs bdag brgyad kyis bskor ba'i tshe/ /tshogs kyi gtso bo 'jig rten skyong / /nor lha 'bum dang bcas te gshegs/ /hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po༞ /'jigs byed dgu yis bskor ba'i tshe/ /drag po'i tshogs kyi gtso bo mdzad/ /'jigs byed 'bum dang bcas te gshegs/ /hūm̐ legs ldan mgon po nag po khyod/ /grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig par byed/ /sdang dgra sgrol ba'i mthu bo che/ /dregs pa 'bum dang bcas te gshegs/ /bstan srung mgon po nag po khyod/ /chos 'khor yongs kyi srog shing ste/ /dam tshig can gyi dgra lha yin/ /srog gcod 'bum dang bcas te gshegs/ /hūm̐ gsang ba chen po'i gnas mchog 'dir/ /sha khrag gtor ma ri ltar spung / /dza gad bdud rtsi rgya mtshor 'khyil/ /dri bsung dud pa sprin ltar gtibs/ /'dod dgu sna tshogs char ltar 'babs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang / /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'dis/ /dam can mgon po 'khor bcas mchod/ /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin brlabs nas/ /sngar bcol gtang rag 'di 'bul lo/ /da bcol zhu skyems 'di 'dren no/ /bzhes cig rol cig dgongs par mdzod/ /mchod ni dam rdzas gtor mas mchod/ /gsol ni spyan gzigs mchod pas gsol/ /rten ni ru mtshon mtshon rtags brtan/ /'bod ni dung chen gling bus 'bod/ /g.yab ni dar nag g.yab mos g.yob/ /bskang ni mthun pa'i rdzas kyis bskangs/ /rbad do sdang byed dgra la rbad/ /bskul lo drag po'i las la bskul/ /chos so dpa' bo dmag la chos/ /brten no mgon po rgyang ma ring / /bskur ro mgon po phrag ma dog /g.yab bo mgon po spyan ma rtul/ /'bod do mgon po snyan ma sra/

/gsol lo mgon po thugs ma ring / /gtad do mgon po mthu ma chung / /bskul lo mgon po rtsal ma zhan/ /dam can bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /dam bcas zhal bzhes mdzad pa rnams/ /mthu dang ldan par mnga' gsol lo/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bu bzhin skyongs/ /mthu rtsal ldan par mnga' gsol lo/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i dbu 'phang bstod/ /sha la sred par mnga' gsol lo/ /dgra bo'i sha la hab se hab/ /khrag la rngams par mnga' gsol lo/ /dgra bo'i khrag la hub se hub/ /srog la rngams bar mnga' gsol lo/ /dgra srog da lta chod la shog /dmag dpon chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /sde brgyad dmag dpung dgra la drongs/ /bstan srung chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /bstan la gnod byed rdul du rlog /chos skyong chen por mnga' gsol lo/ /chos 'khor dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /rig 'dzin srung mar mnga' gsol lo/ /gsang sngags mthu dang nus pa skyed/ /rnal 'byor dgra lhar mnga' gsol lo/ /bcol pa'i las rnams myur du sgrubs/ /zhi ba'i las la mnga' gsol lo/ /nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzod/ /rgyas pa'i las la mnga' gsol lo/ /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par spel/ /dbang gi lus la mnga' gsol lo/ /khams gsum thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /drag po'i las la mnga' gsol lo/ /bstan la gnod cing sdang ba dang / /bla ma brnyas shing sems can 'tshe/ /bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pa yi/ /dgra bo dam nyams las ngan 'di/ /da lta bsgral ba'i dus la babs/ /drag po'i mtshon cha char ltar phob/ /'jigs pa'i nga ro 'brug ltar sgrogs/ /sha khrag rus pa tshogs su rol/ /don snying rnam lnga zhal du gsol/ /yan lag mgo chod rgyan du gyis/ /skyobs pa'i lha dang myur du phyes/ /sngon tshe rgyal ba'i bka' ma bcag /bla ma brgyud pa'i dam ma g.yel/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi ngag ma bcag /dus la bab bo srung ma'i tshogs/ /khams gsum dgra bo'i srog dbugs la/ /dbang zhing rngam par mnga' gsol lo/

/zhes tshig rol dgu brdung byas la rnga phyir brdungs su bsgyur/ gong du shā sa na'i sngags rgyun bzung na 'dir bsdus la/ gzungs thag bkrol/ khrag chang 'thor ba la brtson pas/ mdun gyi srung ma rnams las pho nya las mkhan stong gsum khyab par 'phros nas/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las thams cad thog med du sgrub cing / khyad par dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod/ sha khrag rus pa sogs rjes med du bzhes/ rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su drangs par bsams la/ hūm̐ dam can rgya mtsho mthu ma chung / /ma mo mkha' 'gro rtsal ma zhan/ /pho nya las mkhan bang ma bul/ /mgon po rgyab dpung ma zhan cig /lha mo rdzu 'phrul ma chung zhig /gnod sbyin las la ma g.yel cig /pu tra dgra bo ma brjed cig /ru 'dren rngams pa ma chung zhig /pho nya phyi shol ma byed cig /sde brgyad rno ngar ma zhan cig /myur bar dmag la chas pa'i tshe/ /lha srin dmag gis bar snang khengs/ /dregs pa pho yi dmag tshogs de/ /g.yas nas 'gying zhing mtshon cha 'phen/ /dregs pa mo yi dmag tshogs de/ /g.yon nas 'jab cing khrag zor 'phen/ /sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag tshogs de/ /phyogs nas bskor nas dgra yul 'joms/ /bud med nag mo gri thogs brgya/ /mdun nas rgyug cing dgra snying 'byin/ /skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya/ /g.yas nas rngam zhing dgra sha bza'/ /nyan thos dgra bcom chen po brgya/ /g.yon nas 'dur zhing dgra khrag 'thung / /sngags pa nag po khros pa brgya/ /slad nas 'brang zhing dgra bo gsod/ /mon pa gar byed khyug se khyug /mi nag shugs glu kyu ru ru/ /las mkhan 'ur sgra chems se chem/ /pho nya 'dur rgyug sha ra ra/ /bya nag lding skor lings se leng / /khyi nag 'khong zug chems se chem/ /ce spyang 'dur sgra 'u ru ru/ /khyung chen 'brug sgra ldi ri ri/ /dgra la rbad do mthu ma chung / /bgegs la rbad do rtsal ma zhan/ /bdag gi 'khor dang longs spyod dang /

/dbang phyug ye shes rgyas par mdzod/ /hūm̐ phas kyi rbod gtong bzlog pa dang / /nad kha rims kha dgra la bsgyur/ /rkyen kha mtshon kha dgra la bsgyur/ /mi kha god kha dgra la bsgyur/ /bar chad thams cad zhi bar mdzod/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /ri rab rtse ltar mtho bar mdzod/ /rgya mtsho'i mtha' ltar rgyas par mdzod/ /nyi zla'i 'od ltar gsal bar mdzod/ /chu bo'i rgyun ltar ring bar mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /skye 'gro dar zhing bstan pa rgyas/ /yams nad mu ge mi 'byung zhing / /bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog /tshig rol gyi rjes su sbraṃ sbraṃ gcig byas gnyis byas gsum byas dgu brdungs/ 'theng rkang gnyis che gcig bran bdud bskul sh+lau ka gcig la/ gug drag mtshams gcod kyi dbyangs rol dang bcas/ hūm̐ ri rab ri yi rtsa ba nas/ /las mgon chen po sku bskyod cig /nam gyi gung dang nyin gung la/ /dam nyams dgra bo gsod cing byon/ /'khor ni bdud mgon bdun brgya dang / /gza' bdud bdun brgya pho nyar bcas/ /dam la 'das pa'i dgra bo rnams/ /mchod par 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ /mthun pa'i yo byad ji snyed rnams/ /tshogs bcas 'bul lo bstan pa'i las/ /bdag cag bsrung phyir 'dir brten no/ /nag po bran phyir 'dir brten no/ /bka' las ma 'da' 'dir bzhugs shig /dgos 'dod sgrub phyir 'dir bzhugs shig /ji srid ma gshegs bar dag tu/ /gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs nas kyang / /gang bcol las rnams bsgrub tu gsol/ /tshig rol dgu brdung byas la rnga rol bzhag mgon po 'khor bcas 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i ru mtshon gzi brjid nus pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ 'phyar ba dang phyogs su gdengs pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod pa'i nus ldan du gyur/ zhes brjod/ de lta bu'i ru mtshon de nyid mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas sogs la rten du 'bul ba'i tshig gi 'gor bcom rol bsangs lugs/

sh+lau ka gcig la dus gsum bde gshegs ma'i dbyangs rol bcas/ hūm̐ dpal ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /yi dam rgyud sde bzhi yi lha/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /lha srin dregs pa'i 'khor bcas dgongs/ /dpal ldan gur gyi mgon po che/ /e ka dza ṭi 'dod khams ma/ /phyi nang las mgon zangs gri can/ /gnod sbyin nag po yab yum dang / /dam can pu tra ming sring gsum/ /pho nya ru 'dren gaṇ+ḍe'i dmag /bran bdud nag po lcam dral dang / /dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud bcas/ /sde brgyad bshan pa bcas pa nyan/ /bdag la brtser dgongs rten la bzhugs/ /dur khrod 'bar ba'i ro thang 'dir/ /khrag mtsho 'khyil ba'i rba klong ljongs/ /dam nyams baṃ chen bsgyel ba'i khrir/ /brtan par btsugs pa'i ru mtshon mdung / /dpag bsam ljon pa'i srog shing rtser/ /rno dbal gri lcags mdung so la/ /dug khrag sngags rgod ngar dang ldan/ /lhab lhab 'bar ba'i me 'od can/ /g.yag rgod rog po'i rnga g.yab kyi/ /zhol chen sprin nag lta bur gtibs/ /dar nag ba dan 'phen rtse gsum/ /rlung gis spyod pas 'phur lding g.yo/ /sku rten ro ras tsa ka li/ /gsung rten srog 'khor gsang ba'i sngags/ /thugs rten gsal ba'i me long dang / /yon tan rten du nyer lnga'i rdzas/ /'phrin las rten du dar ras 'phan/ bse lcags shing byang dam nyams kyi/ /mgo lag 'gron bu'i len tshar can/ /dril bu g.yer kha'i sil sil 'khrol/ /phun tshogs rgyud las legs grub cing / /ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin brlabs pa'i/ /thug chen 'bar ba drag po'i rten/ /rten mchog ru mtshon rgyal mtshan 'di/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ /bzhugs pa'i pho brang chen por 'dzugs/ /byin rlabs thugs rje'i sprin sngon las/ /dngos grub char rgyun dus 'dir phob/ /dam can srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /'du ba'i gnas dang rten du 'dzugs/ /pad+mo'i mtsho la ngang pa ltar/

'bral med 'dus nas las kun sgrubs/ dregs byed dmag dpung ru mtshon mchog /g.yul las rgyal ba'i rten du 'dzugs/ /bstan dang rnal 'byor bdag cag la/ /sdang byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlog /rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod kyi/ /srog shing tshe yi rten du 'dzugs/ /mi nor chos dang legs tshogs kun/ /rab tu rgyas shing brtan par mdzod/ /de ltar ru mtshon rgyal mtshan 'di/ /sngar bcol legs pa'i rten du 'dzugs/ /da bcol zhu ba'i rten du 'dzugs/ /bsam don sgrub pa'i rten du 'dzugs/ /bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha/ /dam can chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /snang srid dregs byed gzhi bdag rnams/ /ru mtshon 'di la brtan bzhugs nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bstan pa dang / /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kyi/ /nyin mtshan bya ra mel tshe dang / /byang chub bar gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /ces brjod pas/ mdun gyi bla ma yi dam srung ma rnams dang / snang srid kyi dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud thams cad mtsho la char babs pa bzhin du ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan de nyid la thim par bsam zhing / mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug khyed rnams ru mtshon gyi rgyal mtshan 'di la brtan par bzhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag gi srung ma mdzod/ mi nor dgon gnas longs spyod dang bcas pa'i gnyer mdzod cig bstan pa dang rnal 'byor pa la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad skad cig nyid la tshar chod/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi srog la dbang mdzod cig ces lan gsum brjod cing / me tog gtor shis brjod kyi tshig skabs su gang babs brjod/ de nas yig brgya/ ma 'byor ba sogs bzod gsol/ phyogs bcu na sogs brtan bzhugs/ rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa dang bum nang gi ye shes pa la/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs gshegs gsol/

rang nyid kyai rdo rje sogs/ go bgos/ dge ba 'di yis nas/ ji ltar dngos bzhin 'grub par shog bar gyi bsngo smon/ mtshungs med bla ma nas/ nyin mo bde legs ma'i mthar rol chen gyi bar rgyun bskang bzhin bya'o/ /'di ni thug chog rkyang pa gtong ba'i lugs su byas kyi/ gtor bsngo bskang ba dang sbrel nas byed na dam rdzas bkram bskang bsdus bskang sogs kyang bshams la bdag bskyed nas bum bskyed bar gong bzhin/ gtor bsngo nas rdor glu bkra shis smon lam rdzogs pa'i bar byas la/ sbyangs khrus nas thug chog gi bkra shis rdzogs pa'i bar gong bzhin/ gtor 'bul nas mjug chog gi bkra shis rdzogs pa'i bar rgyun bzhin no/ /yang tshogs 'khor byed na/ bstod pa'i mjug gi lha'i tshogs rnams nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar byas la/ sbyangs khrus nas thug chog gi bkra shis kyi bar dang / tshogs dang lhag ma dus mdos bzhin/ gtor 'bul rjes chog rgyun bzhin bya'o/ /zhes gur lha brgyad kho na'i thug chog zur bkol 'di yang / sa skya pa kun blos rag co bla ma dkon mchog yar 'phel gyi ngor sbyar ba'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 20 kun dga' blo gros/ gur mgon lcam dral lha brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa'i ru mtshon 'dzugs chog PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
